_comment: The `instruction` is too explicit and spells out all the operational steps. I suggest making it more high-level.
instruction: Open Accessibility settings, navigate to Keyboard settings, enable Sticky Keys, and leave Sticky Keys turned on.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags = [int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys' -Name 'Flags'); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'STICKY_KEYS_DISABLED' }"
